scope:
Execute NT5 miniport registration/glue instructions with modeled NDIS/kernel calls.
This does not model NIC DMA, networking, or a real kernel DPC scheduler.

tests.test: NDIS 5.0 registration uses the native 96-byte callback layout and preserves stdcall state
UP-only compatibility path rejects other processor counts before NDIS registration
Wrapper and miniport-registration failures propagate and release wrapper ownership
Legacy shutdown registration passes the adapter context and real shutdown callback
UP DPC barrier queues a low-importance entry before waiting and its callback signals the correct event
Serialized array sends record each status and stop at resource exhaustion without touching the unaccepted tail
Contiguous transmit copies valid MDL chains, rejects zero/oversized frames and inconsistent lengths, and restores resources on copy failure
